purpose: Fresh layout and mood invention; replaces screenshot paintovers as active inspiration.
roast: Use case: stylized-concept. Invent an original Hong Kong / Kowloon neighborhood shop from scratch: NO reference image and no need to match any existing 3D scene. This is fresh architectural and layout exploration for a game environment. Art direction inspired by original 1990s Ghost in the Shell and Akira hand-painted background art: exquisite industrial design, grounded retrofuturism, complex accreted architecture, crisp perspective ink and painterly gouache surfaces. Slate-blue and petrol-blue shadows, cyan-blue overcast street bounce, localized warm amber practical light; rich yet restrained palette, aged jade, faded oxblood signs, warm wood and ivory. Dense urban services, pipe junctions, proper brackets, mismatched metal/concrete/tile infill, uneven canopy levels, aircon cages, conduits with real endpoints. Buildable architecture that has accumulated over decades, not uniformly random greebles. Intricate weathering, runoff, soot and rubbed edges with quiet resting areas. Visible functional shop depth and continuous clear human circulation. Atmospheric blue-hour environment without crushed blacks or blanket blue filter. No people or characters, no futuristic holograms, no purple cyberpunk neon, no motorcycles. Single full-bleed landscape concept artwork, no multiple panels, no annotations or captions. Perspective reveals the shop layout from street level with slightly elevated eye and an open frontage. SUBJECT: a compact roast-duck restaurant on an awkward corner lot, with a short angled or L-shaped glazed takeaway case of whole roasted ducks immediately beside a small payment ledge at the street, a convincing modest wok kitchen and extraction hood behind it, and a separate narrow path leading to three small mismatched tables along the opposite wall plus a rear seating nook. A glimpse of tiny rear service door adds depth. Explore an asymmetric frontage and layered split canopies, narrow raised sill and triangular leftover service space. Make food presentation appetizing and function readable. Stainless tables show only subtle mottled grease/water wear in reflectance, not heavy scratch stripes. New composition and arrangement: avoid a giant continuous front counter or a huge kitchen. Industrial ducts and old wiring sit around a strongly designed roofline and blue shadowed building recesses.

SUBJECT: a cramped liquor and provisions shop whose layout is an original arrangement: narrow recessed central entry between two unequal street display bays, tall deep wall shelves following a stepped wall, short offset islands forming a readable winding but clear path, and a small checkout counter near the entrance with register visible. Thick old wood shelves mixed with one enamel-metal bottle rack, stacks of colored bottle crates, hanging sachets, jars, tins, glass bottles. A high rear transom and side stockroom opening suggest real depth. Explore asymmetrical facade with a higher narrow right bay, a deep blue steel lintel, cream/red sign, projecting ventilation box and a sheltered side alcove. Goods are crowded in supported clusters while the customer aisle remains open.

SUBJECT: a street greengrocer with an original U-shaped market layout, not a wall of identical front-facing tiers. Low produce islands and diagonally set wooden bins draw shoppers into a clear central passage; deeper side stands follow irregular walls; cashier at a small side counter overlooking entry, storage nook and rear door. Weathered red, orange, jade and light-green crates vary BETWEEN boxes, subtle wood variation within a box. Red lamp shades highlight fruit and hanging bananas. An asymmetric patched corrugated awning, old balcony/cantilever glimpse, concrete pier, vertical pipe bank, drain and old sliding gate form an industrial urban shell. Balance crowded organic produce with a clear walking route and a visually distinct scale to the other shops.
